exposure: maternal red blood cell (RBC) alloimmunization (HDFN pregnancy status)
outcome: postnatal disorders of the nervous system
cohort: Singleton pregnancies in Sweden (2000-2021), Finland (2000-2021), and Denmark (1997-2018) identified through national health registers due to potential alloimmunization or HDFN-related diagnoses.
finding: Neonates with HDFN, especially those treated with intrauterine or neonatal transfusion, had lower gestational age, birth weight and length, higher rates of neonatal unit admission, and more frequent postnatal diagnoses of growth disturbances and nervous system disorders compared to non-HDFN neonates.
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries were more frequent in HDFN pregnancies.
birth_weight: measured (found to be lower in HDFN neonates)
gest_age: measured (found to be lower in HDFN neonates)
